verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: the striped field holds a large VOLTSTRIDE box, and below it sits a full-width lime panel with a strong headline and CTA. But the '48H ONLY' badge has shrunk to near-illegible text and is jammed into the top-left corner, and the subcopy leaves the word 'stock.' alone on its own line. B has fatal flaws. The badge is a tiny unreadable pink dot at the top-right edge. The lime panel swallows almost the whole canvas, so the striped brand pattern is reduced to a thin border. Large dead gaps separate the subcopy, product and CTA, leaving the CTA stranded at the bottom, and the subcopy is cramped right under the headline.
